_comment: Per-host identity, read by the app (src/data/brands.ts) and by Node (scripts/build-assets.mjs, scripts/build-hosts.mjs). One source. Colours were read off the organiser's own badge (public/brand/foodera/logo.png once they send the file); every text/ground pair is annotated with its contrast ratio. cream/cream2 are the 2026-10 grey canvas and card tinted 8%/5% with the show's mark colour, so white panels keep their edge on every show.

palette._note2026_10_15: Samarkand tilework, read off the FOODERA badge (images/brand-masters/foodera-expo-2026-badge.png): ivory ground #F0EEE4, azure star and wordmark #2490CC, gold #CCA878. Lapis #0F3352 is the azure taken to night; white on it 13:1, gold-soft on it 6.6:1; gold text #7A5A28 4.9:1 on the ivory canvas.

_heroNote: hero: 'light' for shows whose logo is drawn on white (FOODERA, AGROPRO, WORLD EDU) — the event hero becomes a white panel tinted with the show's mark colour, so the full-colour logo sits on its own ground; 'dark' for logos drawn on black (BUILD PRO, ECOM, PROMOTORS).
